structure_note: Likely structure, inferred from SA new-grad reports: about 3 interviews, each mixing 2 Leadership Principle questions with a technical or customer segment. Confirm the format with the recruiter.

stages.title: Online assessment
stages.note: Completed Oct 14. Nothing to prepare; the loop is next.

stages.title: Round 1: LPs and resume deep dive
stages.note: Expect 2 to 3 LP questions and drill-downs on your numbers. Lead with S1, S2, S5.

checklist.text: Say the 60-second pitch out loud three times with the timer
Rehearse S1, S2, S5 in under 90 seconds each, answer first
Score 90% or better on the numbers quiz
Say how each lead metric was measured, or say plainly that you would need to check
Draft the failure, disagreement, and mentoring stories from real events
Record one answer and count every "we" that should be "I"

stages.title: Round 2: AWS fundamentals and whiteboard
stages.note: Rapid-fire fundamentals, then one architecture on the whiteboard. Clarify before drawing.

checklist.text: Write the 7-step whiteboard framework from memory
Finish 4 of the 6 designs under the 30-minute timer
Answer all 24 rapid-fire questions in two sentences each
Recite the 6 pillars, the 7 Rs, and the 4 DR tiers with RPO and RTO
Say your resume-to-AWS mapping out loud, one line per row
Draw one design on paper by hand, not on a screen

stages.title: Round 3: customer role-play and LPs
stages.note: Ask before proposing. Match the audience. Close with next steps. Lead with S1, S4, S9.

checklist.text: Run two role-plays out loud with the checklist
Explain containers and the cloud bill to a CFO with no jargon
Rehearse S1, S4, S9 with the SA twist at the end
Pick two questions to ask your interviewers
Practice the close: restate, recommend, next step
